snippet.title: Wai Kru Ram Muay Explained | Wildcat Muay Thai
snippet.h1: What Wai Kru Ram Muay Really Means, From a Chiang Mai Camp
snippet.description: Meaw and the coaches at our Chiang Mai camp explain wai kru ram muay: what it means, why fighters dance, and what to expect if you visit.

structure.heading: What Wai Kru Ram Muay Actually Means
structure.purpose: Opens on a lived scene at the Wildcat ring, which doubles as the answer to PAA "Why do Muay Thai fighters dance before a fight?" (explicitly anchored here). Then etymology breakdown (wai / khru / ram / muay). Answers PAA "What does Wai Kru Ram Muay mean?".

structure.heading: The Two Parts: Wai Kru and Ram Muay
structure.purpose: Explain the two-stage structure (paying respect, then the dance). Answers PAA "What is the difference between Wai Kru and Ram Muay?". Frames the two H3 subsections below.

structure.heading: Sealing the Ring
structure.purpose: Merged from a standalone H2 into a H3 nested under 'The Two Parts' (heading-count fix). Describe circling the ring, kneeling at the four directions, touching the ropes.

structure.heading: Is It Religious, or Is It Respect?
structure.purpose: Nuance the Buddhist/animist roots without settling a theological debate; frame as respect to teachers, parents, ancestors. Answers PAA "Is the Wai Kru ritual religious?".

structure.heading: The Ram Muay Dance: Movements and Meaning
structure.purpose: Describe typical movement patterns and their general symbolism without over-specifying one fixed choreography. Frames the two H3 subsections below.

structure.heading: Every Camp Has Its Own Style
structure.purpose: Merged from a standalone H2 into a H3 nested under 'The Ram Muay Dance' (heading-count fix). Explain regional/lineage variation (Korat, Chaiya, Lopburi, and others) and that each kru passes down their own version. Answers PAA "Do all Muay Thai fighters have their own Ram Muay?". Do not attribute a specific named regional style to Wildcat's coaches without confirmation.

structure.heading: The Mongkhon and Pra Jiad: What Fighters Wear
structure.purpose: Merged from a standalone H2 into a H3 nested at the end of 'The Ram Muay Dance' (heading-count fix). Brief 2-3 sentence mention of the sacred headband and armbands worn during the ritual and removed before the fight. Deliberately not targeting "muay thai headband" (reserved for a future dedicated article) — partially answers PAA on the Mongkhon without exhausting the topic.

structure.heading: The Sarama Music That Drives It
structure.purpose: Describe the live musical ensemble (pi muay, drums, cymbals) that sets the tempo of the dance.

structure.heading: Who Becomes a Kru
structure.purpose: Explain what a kru is beyond "coach" (lineage, transmission) and why students still perform wai kru in training, not just before fights. Required link to /about/coaches.

structure.heading: What to Expect If You're New to This
structure.purpose: Practical, respectful guidance for a visitor or beginner witnessing or performing their first wai kru ram muay. Family framing, not hardcore. Required link to /classes/beginners.

claims.statement: Wai kru ram muay is a two-part pre-fight ritual: wai kru (paying respect to teachers) then ram muay (the ritual dance).
claims.allowed_wording: Formuler comme structure largement documentée (corroborée par 5/5 résultats SERP) sans citer de source précise tant que /seo-sources n'a pas tourné.
claims.limits: Ne pas présenter comme fait absolu sans passage par /seo-sources avant /seo-enrich. Pas de citation verbatim disponible pour l'instant (voir brief § Citations exploitables).

claims.statement: Regional or camp-specific ram muay styles exist (e.g. Korat, Chaiya, Lopburi, and other named lineages).
claims.allowed_wording: Mentionner comme exemples connus de variation régionale, au conditionnel/général.
claims.limits: Ne jamais attribuer un style régional nommé précis aux coachs de Wildcat sans confirmation explicite de Meaw. Pas de citation verbatim disponible pour l'instant (voir brief § Citations exploitables).

claims.statement: Wildcat's coaches perform their own ram muay at the camp, e.g. during fight nights or demonstrations.
claims.allowed_wording: Si non confirmé au moment de la rédaction, formuler au général ("many camps, including ours, keep this tradition alive") plutôt qu'un fait de calendrier précis.
claims.limits: Needs_review — à confirmer par Jonathan/Meaw avant publication. Ne pas inventer de fréquence ou d'occasion précise.

claims.statement: Wildcat is a family-run, open-air Muay Thai camp in Hang Dong, Chiang Mai, welcoming to beginners.
claims.allowed_wording: Reprendre tel quel, source interne docs/brand/proofs.md et docs/brand/identity.md (pas une URL externe, donc pas de SRC- id).
claims.limits: Ne pas prétendre que le camp convient à tout le monde.

claims.statement: The wai kru ram muay ritual has roots connected to Buddhist and animist tradition (respect to teachers, parents, ancestors).
claims.allowed_wording: Formuler avec prudence ("often described as", "rooted in") plutôt qu'en fait théologique tranché.
claims.limits: Ne pas transformer en avis religieux définitif ; passer par /seo-sources si une affirmation précise est conservée. Pas de citation verbatim disponible pour l'instant (voir brief § Citations exploitables).
